CHAPTER 11 — अनुच्छेदलेखनम् (ANUCCHEDALEKHANAM — Paragraph Writing in Sanskrit)

Introduction — अनुच्छेदः किम्?

The word अनुच्छेदः means a 'paragraph' — a small group of sentences that together develop ONE idea. अनुच्छेदलेखनम् is therefore the skill of paragraph writing: taking a single topic (विषयः) and expressing it completely, clearly and attractively in a few well-connected Sanskrit sentences. Just as a necklace is not a heap of beads but beads strung on one thread, a paragraph is not a heap of sentences but sentences strung on one thread of thought. In this senior-secondary lesson (NIOS Sanskrit, Course 309) we learn the qualities of a good अनुच्छेद, a step-by-step method of writing one, the connective words (सम्बन्धबोधकपदानि) that bind sentences together, four complete model paragraphs, the common errors to avoid, and the grammar — वाक्यरचना, कारक-विभक्ति and सन्धि — that keeps our composition correct.

Qualities of a good paragraph (उत्तम-अनुच्छेदस्य गुणाः)

1) एकसूत्रता (Unity): A paragraph must deal with ONE main idea only. Every sentence should serve that idea. If the topic is मम विद्यालयः, a sentence about your uncle's clinic breaks the unity and must be removed. One paragraph = one topic — this is the first and greatest rule.

2) संगतिः (Coherence): The sentences must be logically connected — each sentence should grow naturally out of the previous one, so the reader moves smoothly from beginning to end. Coherence is achieved by arranging ideas sensibly and by using connective words such as ततः, अतः, किन्तु, यतः.

3) क्रमबद्धता (Sequence/Order): Ideas must come in a proper order — general to particular, cause to effect, morning to evening, first to last. A jumbled order (samapana first, introduction last) destroys the paragraph even if every sentence is individually correct.

4) संक्षेपः (Brevity): A paragraph is short — usually five to eight sentences. Say what is necessary, omit what is not. Repetition of the same idea in different words (पुनरुक्तिः) is a fault.

5) भाषाशुद्धिः (Correct language): The Sanskrit must be grammatically correct — right विभक्ति, right वचन, subject-verb agreement, and clean सन्धि. Simple, correct sentences are far better than long, faulty ones.

Structure of a paragraph (अनुच्छेदस्य रचना)

A well-built अनुच्छेद has three parts:

(क) मुख्यवाक्यम् (Topic sentence): The first sentence, which states the main idea of the whole paragraph. E.g. 'अनुशासनं जीवनस्य अलङ्कारः अस्ति।' The reader should know the theme from this one sentence.

(ख) समर्थकवाक्यानि (Supporting sentences): The middle sentences (three to six), which expand, explain, illustrate and justify the main idea — with details, examples and reasons.

(ग) समापनवाक्यम् (Concluding sentence): The last sentence, which sums up the idea or states its lesson. It often begins with अतः (therefore) — e.g. 'अतः सर्वे छात्राः अनुशासनं पालयेयुः।' The conclusion must never open a NEW topic.

Step-by-step method (लेखनविधिः)

Step 1 — विषयचयनम् (Choose the topic): Fix the topic clearly. Choose (or accept) one limited subject: not 'the world' but 'पर्यावरणरक्षणम्'.

Step 2 — विचारसंग्रहः (Collect ideas): Think and jot down four to six points about the topic — what it is, why it matters, examples, what should be done.

Step 3 — रूपरेखा (Make an outline): Arrange the collected points in a sensible order — which point makes the मुख्यवाक्य, which points support it, which point concludes.

Step 4 — लेखनम् (Draft): Write the paragraph in simple, short Sanskrit sentences, mostly in लट् लकार (present tense), joining them with suitable connectives. One idea per sentence.

Step 5 — संशोधनम् (Revise): Read the draft again. Check unity (any stray sentence?), order, विभक्ति and वचन agreement, spelling and सन्धि. Correct and produce the fair copy.

Connectives — सम्बन्धबोधकपदानि (the glue of the paragraph)

Connective words tie sentences into a flowing whole. Learn these with their use:
• ततः = then, after that. 'प्रथमं सः स्नानं करोति, ततः पूजां करोति।' (First he bathes, then he worships.)
• अपि च = moreover, and also. 'सः पठति। अपि च सः क्रीडति।' (He studies. Moreover he plays.)
• अतः = therefore, hence. 'वर्षा भवति, अतः छत्रं नय।' (It is raining, therefore take an umbrella.)
• किन्तु / परन्तु = but, however. 'सः धनवान् अस्ति, किन्तु सुखी नास्ति।' (He is rich, but not happy.)
• यतः = because, since. 'यतः वृक्षाः वायुं शुद्धं कुर्वन्ति, अतः ते रक्षणीयाः।' (Because trees purify the air, they must be protected.) यतः is often paired with अतः.
• तथापि = even then, nevertheless. 'सः श्रान्तः आसीत्, तथापि अपठत्।' (He was tired; nevertheless he studied.)
• एवम् = thus, in this way. 'एवम् सः दिनं यापयति।' (Thus he spends his day.)
• प्रथमम् = first; अन्ते = finally, at the end. Useful for sequence: प्रथमम् ... ततः ... अन्ते ...
• यदा ... तदा = when ... then. 'यदा वसन्तः आगच्छति, तदा पुष्पाणि विकसन्ति।'
• यदि ... तर्हि = if ... then. 'यदि वयं परिश्रमं कुर्मः, तर्हि सफलताम् आप्नुमः।'
• च = and. Note: च is placed AFTER the word(s) it joins — 'रामः श्यामः च', never before them.

Four model paragraphs (आदर्श-अनुच्छेदाः) — original compositions with explanation

(1) मम विद्यालयः (My School)
मम विद्यालयः नगरस्य मध्यभागे अस्ति। सः विशालः सुन्दरश्च अस्ति। विद्यालये विंशतिः कक्ष्याः, एकः पुस्तकालयः, एकं विज्ञानागारं, विशालं क्रीडाक्षेत्रं च सन्ति। अस्माकं शिक्षकाः विद्वांसः स्नेहशीलाश्च सन्ति। ते अस्मान् श्रद्धया पाठयन्ति। छात्राः प्रातः प्रार्थनां कुर्वन्ति, ततः पठनम् आरभन्ते। अपि च ते क्रीडाक्षेत्रे कन्दुकक्रीडां कुर्वन्ति। अतः मम विद्यालयः मह्यं बहु रोचते।
Explanation: The topic sentence states where the school is; supporting sentences describe its size, facilities (twenty classrooms, a library, a science laboratory, a large playground), the learned and affectionate teachers, and the students' routine (prayer, then study — ततः; moreover games — अपि च); the conclusion (अतः ... मह्यं रोचते — 'therefore my school pleases me greatly'; रुच् takes the dative मह्यम्) sums up the writer's love for the school. Note the unity: every sentence is about the school.

(2) पर्यावरणम् (The Environment)
पर्यावरणं जीवनस्य आधारः अस्ति। वृक्षाः शुद्धं वायुं यच्छन्ति, नद्यः जलं यच्छन्ति। किन्तु अद्य मानवः वृक्षान् छिनत्ति, जलं मलिनं करोति च। यतः प्रदूषणं वर्धते, अतः रोगाः अपि वर्धन्ते। वयं वृक्षारोपणं कुर्याम, जलं रक्षेम, स्वच्छतां च पालयेम। यदि वयं पर्यावरणं रक्षामः, तर्हि पर्यावरणम् अस्मान् रक्षति। अतः पर्यावरणरक्षणं सर्वेषां कर्तव्यम् अस्ति।
Explanation: Main idea — the environment is the basis (आधारः) of life. Supports: nature's gifts (trees give pure air, rivers give water); the problem introduced by किन्तु (man cuts trees and dirties water); cause-effect with यतः ... अतः (because pollution grows, diseases grow); duties in the polite विधिलिङ् (कुर्याम, रक्षेम, पालयेम — 'let us plant, protect, keep clean'); a conditional यदि ... तर्हि; conclusion with अतः — protecting the environment is everyone's duty.

(3) दीपावली (Deepavali)
दीपावली भारतीयानां प्रमुखः उत्सवः अस्ति। अयम् उत्सवः कार्तिकमासस्य अमावास्यायां भवति। तस्मिन् दिने जनाः गृहाणि स्वच्छानि कुर्वन्ति, दीपान् ज्वालयन्ति च। बालकाः नूतनानि वस्त्राणि धारयन्ति, मिष्टान्नानि खादन्ति च। रात्रौ सर्वत्र दीपानां पङ्क्तयः शोभन्ते। अपि च जनाः लक्ष्मीदेव्याः पूजनं कुर्वन्ति। किन्तु वयं स्फोटकानां प्रयोगं न कुर्याम, यतः तेन प्रदूषणं भवति। अतः दीपावली प्रकाशस्य आनन्दस्य च उत्सवः अस्ति।
Explanation: Topic sentence — Deepavali is the chief festival of Indians. Supports: it falls on the new-moon day (अमावास्या) of the month कार्तिक; people clean houses and light lamps; children wear new clothes and eat sweets; rows of lamps (दीपानां पङ्क्तयः) shine at night; moreover people worship goddess Lakshmi. A modern caution with किन्तु ... यतः: let us not use firecrackers, because that causes pollution. Conclusion: Deepavali is the festival of light and joy.

(4) अनुशासनम् (Discipline)
अनुशासनं जीवनस्य अलङ्कारः अस्ति। यत्र अनुशासनं तत्र सफलता। छात्रः प्रातः उत्तिष्ठति, व्यायामं करोति, समये च विद्यालयं गच्छति — एतत् अनुशासनम्। सूर्यः समये उदेति, ऋतवः क्रमेण आगच्छन्ति — एवं प्रकृतिः अपि अनुशासनं पालयति। यः अनुशासनं पालयति, सः जीवने उन्नतिं प्राप्नोति। किन्तु यः तत् न पालयति, सः बहूनि कष्टानि अनुभवति। अतः सर्वे छात्राः अनुशासनं पालयेयुः।
Explanation: Topic sentence — discipline is the ornament (अलङ्कारः) of life; 'where there is discipline, there is success' (यत्र ... तत्र). Supports: a student's disciplined routine; nature's own discipline (the sun rises on time, the seasons come in order — एवम् 'thus'); the यः ... सः construction contrasts the one who keeps discipline (gains progress) with the one who does not (suffers many hardships — note the neuter plural बहूनि कष्टानि). Conclusion in विधिलिङ्: therefore all students should observe discipline (पालयेयुः).

Common errors to avoid (सामान्यदोषाः)

1) Breaking unity: adding a sentence unrelated to the topic. 2) Jumbled order: conclusion before supports. 3) पुनरुक्तिः: repeating the same idea. 4) Agreement errors: subject and verb must agree in पुरुष and वचन — बालिका गायति (not गायन्ति); बालकाः क्रीडन्ति (not क्रीडति). 5) Wrong विभक्ति: with an active verb the doer stays in प्रथमा — रामः पुस्तकं पठति (not रामेण ... पठति); the object of गम् takes द्वितीया — विद्यालयं गच्छति (not विद्यालये गच्छति for 'goes TO school'). 6) Missing connectives, which makes the paragraph a heap of disconnected statements. 7) Careless सन्धि or spelling.

Grammar for composition (रचनायां व्याकरणम्)

(A) वाक्यरचना (Sentence construction): The natural Sanskrit order is कर्ता — कर्म — क्रिया (subject — object — verb): छात्रः पाठं पठति। The verb usually stands last. The verb agrees with the कर्ता in पुरुष (person) and वचन (number): अहं पठामि, त्वं पठसि, सः पठति, ते पठन्ति। An adjective agrees with its noun in लिङ्ग, वचन and विभक्ति: विशालं क्रीडाक्षेत्रम्, नूतनानि वस्त्राणि, स्नेहशीलाः शिक्षकाः।

(B) कारक-विभक्ति in composition: कर्ता (doer) → प्रथमा (छात्रः); कर्म (object) → द्वितीया (पाठम्); करण (instrument, 'by/with') → तृतीया (कन्दुकेन क्रीडति); सम्प्रदान (recipient, 'to/for') → चतुर्थी (छात्राय पुस्तकं यच्छति; also मह्यं रोचते with रुच्); अपादान (separation, 'from') → पञ्चमी (वृक्षात् पत्रं पतति); अधिकरण (location/time, 'in/at/on') → सप्तमी (विद्यालये, प्रातःकाले, अमावास्यायाम्)। षष्ठी shows सम्बन्ध (relation, 'of') — जीवनस्य आधारः, दीपानां पङ्क्तयः — and is strictly not a कारक, since it links noun to noun, not noun to verb.

(C) सन्धि in writing: Clean joining makes prose elegant: न + अस्ति = नास्ति; च + अपि = चापि; इति + उक्त्वा = इत्युक्त्वा; सुन्दरः + च = सुन्दरश्च (visarga before च becomes श्); विशालः + च = विशालश्च। In your own paragraphs use simple, well-known sandhis; where a join would confuse the reader, you may keep the words separate — clarity first. Being able to split (सन्धि-विच्छेदः) what you have joined is proof that the join is correct.

SUMMARY (सारांशः)

An अनुच्छेद is a short set of sentences developing ONE idea. Its virtues are एकसूत्रता (unity), संगतिः (coherence), क्रमबद्धता (order), संक्षेपः (brevity) and भाषाशुद्धिः (correct language). Its body has a मुख्यवाक्य (topic sentence), समर्थकवाक्यानि (supports) and a समापनवाक्य (conclusion, often beginning अतः). Write by five steps — choose the topic, collect ideas, outline, draft in simple लट्-लकार sentences, revise. Bind sentences with connectives: ततः, अपि च, अतः, किन्तु, यतः, तथापि, एवम्, प्रथमम्/अन्ते, यदा-तदा, यदि-तर्हि, च. Four model paragraphs — मम विद्यालयः, पर्यावरणम्, दीपावली, अनुशासनम् — showed the structure in action. Avoid the common faults (broken unity, jumbled order, repetition, agreement and विभक्ति errors), and let कारक-विभक्ति, subject-verb agreement and clean सन्धि keep your Sanskrit correct. Practise: a paragraph a day makes composition easy.

topics.name: अनुच्छेदः — Meaning and Qualities of a Paragraph
topics.description: What an अनुच्छेद (paragraph) is — a small group of sentences developing one idea — and the qualities of a good paragraph: एकसूत्रता (unity), संगतिः (coherence), क्रमबद्धता (sequence), संक्षेपः (brevity) and भाषाशुद्धिः (correct language).

topics.name: Structure — मुख्यवाक्यम्, समर्थकवाक्यानि, समापनवाक्यम्
topics.description: The three-part architecture of a paragraph: the topic sentence (मुख्यवाक्यम्) stating the main idea, the supporting sentences (समर्थकवाक्यानि) that expand and justify it, and the concluding sentence (समापनवाक्यम्) that sums up, often beginning with अतः.

topics.name: लेखनविधिः — Step-by-step Method of Writing
topics.description: The five steps of paragraph writing: विषयचयनम् (choosing the topic), विचारसंग्रहः (collecting ideas), रूपरेखा (outlining), लेखनम् (drafting in simple लट्-लकार sentences), and संशोधनम् (revising for unity, order, grammar and सन्धि).

topics.name: सम्बन्धबोधकपदानि — Connectives in Composition
topics.description: The connective words that bind sentences into a flowing paragraph — ततः, अपि च, अतः, किन्तु/परन्तु, यतः, तथापि, एवम्, प्रथमम्/अन्ते, यदा...तदा, यदि...तर्हि, च — with their meanings and model usage.

topics.name: आदर्श-अनुच्छेदाः — Model Paragraphs
topics.description: Four complete original model paragraphs in simple correct Sanskrit — मम विद्यालयः, पर्यावरणम्, दीपावली, अनुशासनम् — each analysed for topic sentence, supports, connectives and conclusion, with English explanation.

topics.name: Grammar and Common Errors in Composition
topics.description: Grammar that keeps composition correct — वाक्यरचना (कर्ता-कर्म-क्रिया order, subject-verb and adjective-noun agreement), कारक-विभक्ति usage, सन्धि in writing — and the common errors: broken unity, jumbled order, पुनरुक्तिः, agreement and विभक्ति mistakes.

chapter_summary.title: अनुच्छेदलेखनम् (Anucchedalekhanam) — Chapter Summary
chapter_summary.intro: This NIOS Senior Secondary Sanskrit (309) summary covers Chapter 11 on paragraph writing: what makes a good अनुच्छेद (unity, coherence, order), its three-part structure, the five-step writing method, the connectives that bind sentences, four model paragraphs, and the grammar and common errors of composition.

sections.heading: What a paragraph is and its qualities
bullets: An अनुच्छेद is a small group of sentences developing ONE idea — like beads strung on one thread of thought.
एकसूत्रता (unity): every sentence serves the single topic; an unrelated sentence must be removed.
संगतिः (coherence) and क्रमबद्धता (order): sentences grow out of one another and follow a sensible sequence (general to particular, cause to effect).
संक्षेपः (brevity — usually 5-8 sentences, no पुनरुक्तिः) and भाषाशुद्धिः (correct विभक्ति, वचन, सन्धि) complete the five qualities.

sections.heading: Structure: topic sentence, supports, conclusion
bullets: मुख्यवाक्यम् — the first sentence, stating the main idea, e.g. 'अनुशासनं जीवनस्य अलङ्कारः अस्ति।'
समर्थकवाक्यानि — the middle sentences that expand, illustrate and justify the idea with details, examples and reasons.
समापनवाक्यम् — the last sentence sums up or states the lesson, often beginning with अतः; it never opens a new topic.

sections.heading: The five-step writing method
bullets: विषयचयनम्: fix one limited topic; विचारसंग्रहः: jot 4-6 points about it.
रूपरेखा: order the points — which becomes the मुख्यवाक्य, which support, which concludes.
लेखनम्: draft in simple, short लट्-लकार sentences joined by connectives — one idea per sentence.
संशोधनम्: re-read for unity, order, agreement, विभक्ति, spelling and सन्धि, then make the fair copy.

sections.heading: Connectives — the glue of composition
bullets: Sequence: प्रथमम् (first), ततः (then), अन्ते (finally); addition: च (placed AFTER the words joined), अपि च (moreover).
Reason and result: यतः (because) often pairs with अतः (therefore) — 'यतः वृक्षाः वायुं शुद्धं कुर्वन्ति, अतः ते रक्षणीयाः।'
Contrast: किन्तु / परन्तु (but), तथापि (nevertheless) — 'सः धनवान् अस्ति, किन्तु सुखी नास्ति।'
Paired frames: यदा ... तदा (when ... then), यदि ... तर्हि (if ... then), and एवम् (thus) to round off a description.

sections.heading: Model paragraphs, grammar and common errors
bullets: Four models show the structure in action: मम विद्यालयः (school and its facilities), पर्यावरणम् (nature's gifts, pollution, duties), दीपावली (Kartika Amavasya, lamps, Lakshmi-puja, no crackers), अनुशासनम् (discipline in life and nature).
वाक्यरचना: default order कर्ता-कर्म-क्रिया; verb agrees with subject in पुरुष and वचन; adjective agrees with noun in लिङ्ग, वचन, विभक्ति.
कारक-विभक्ति: कर्ता प्रथमा, कर्म द्वितीया, करण तृतीया, सम्प्रदान चतुर्थी, अपादान पञ्चमी, अधिकरण सप्तमी; षष्ठी shows सम्बन्ध and is not a कारक.
सन्धि in writing: न + अस्ति = नास्ति, च + अपि = चापि, सुन्दरः + च = सुन्दरश्च; prefer simple sandhis, clarity first.
Avoid: broken unity, jumbled order, पुनरुक्तिः, agreement errors (बालिका गायति, not गायन्ति) and wrong विभक्ति (रामः पठति, not रामेण पठति).

key_takeaways: One paragraph = one idea: एकसूत्रता is the first rule of अनुच्छेदलेखनम्.
Build every paragraph in three parts — मुख्यवाक्यम्, समर्थकवाक्यानि, समापनवाक्यम् (the conclusion often begins with अतः).
Write by five steps: choose the topic, collect ideas, outline, draft simply, revise (संशोधनम्).
Connectives bind sentences: ततः (then), अतः (therefore), किन्तु (but), यतः (because), अपि च (moreover), यदि-तर्हि (if-then).
The verb agrees with the कर्ता in पुरुष and वचन, and the adjective with its noun in लिङ्ग, वचन and विभक्ति.
Use the right कारक-विभक्ति — doer in प्रथमा, object in द्वितीया, place/time in सप्तमी — and simple clean सन्धि (नास्ति, चापि, सुन्दरश्च).
Avoid the common faults: stray sentences, jumbled order, repetition (पुनरुक्तिः) and grammar slips — revise before the fair copy.

glossary.definition: A paragraph — a small group of connected sentences that together develop one single idea.
Unity of theme: every sentence of the paragraph serves one main idea; nothing unrelated is admitted.
Coherence — the logical connection by which each sentence grows naturally out of the previous one.
Proper sequence of ideas — general to particular, cause to effect, first to last.
Brevity: saying what is necessary in about five to eight sentences and omitting the rest.
The topic sentence — usually the first sentence — which states the main idea of the whole paragraph.
Supporting sentences that expand, explain, illustrate and justify the main idea with details and reasons.
The concluding sentence which sums up the idea or states its lesson, often beginning with अतः.
The outline — the ordered skeleton of points prepared before drafting the paragraph.
Revision — re-reading the draft to check unity, order, agreement, विभक्ति, spelling and सन्धि.
Connective words such as ततः, अतः, किन्तु, यतः, अपि च that tie sentences into a flowing paragraph.
Faulty repetition — saying the same idea again in different words within the paragraph.
The relation of a noun to the verb's action (doer, object, instrument, recipient, source, location), expressed by विभक्ति endings.
The optative mood used for polite advice in conclusions — पालयेयुः 'they should observe', कुर्याम 'let us do'.
Splitting a joined (sandhi) form back into its parts, e.g. नास्ति = न + अस्ति — the test of a correct join.

worksheet.title: Worksheet — अनुच्छेदलेखनम् (NIOS Sanskrit 309, Chapter 11)
worksheet.instructions: Attempt all questions. Write Sanskrit in Devanagari and explanations in English. Follow the paragraph structure — मुख्यवाक्य, समर्थकवाक्य, समापनवाक्य — wherever you are asked to compose.

questions.question: Define अनुच्छेद and name any two qualities of a good paragraph.
questions.answer: An अनुच्छेद (paragraph) is a small group of connected sentences that together develop ONE idea. Two qualities: एकसूत्रता (unity — every sentence serves the single topic) and संगतिः (coherence — sentences are logically connected and flow smoothly). (Also acceptable: क्रमबद्धता, संक्षेपः, भाषाशुद्धिः.)
questions.explanation: Definition plus any two of the five qualities taught in the lesson.

questions.question: Perform the सन्धि: (a) न + अस्ति (b) च + अपि. Then split (सन्धि-विच्छेद): सुन्दरश्च.
questions.answer: (a) न + अस्ति = नास्ति (अ + अ = आ). (b) च + अपि = चापि (अ + अ = आ). Split: सुन्दरश्च = सुन्दरः + च (the visarga ः before च becomes श्).
questions.explanation: Simple vowel sandhi and visarga sandhi used in composition.

questions.question: Give the English meanings of: ततः, अतः, किन्तु, यतः.
questions.answer: ततः = then / after that; अतः = therefore / hence; किन्तु = but / however; यतः = because / since.
questions.explanation: Four core connectives; यतः (because) typically pairs with अतः (therefore).

questions.question: Name the three parts of a paragraph in order and state the function of each in one line.
questions.answer: 1) मुख्यवाक्यम् (topic sentence) — states the main idea at the start. 2) समर्थकवाक्यानि (supporting sentences) — expand, illustrate and justify the idea with details, examples and reasons. 3) समापनवाक्यम् (concluding sentence) — sums up the idea or states its lesson, often beginning with अतः; it never opens a new topic.
questions.explanation: The three-part architecture of an अनुच्छेद.

questions.question: Use अतः in one Sanskrit sentence and यतः in another. Give the English meaning of each sentence.
questions.answer: Model: (1) वर्षा भवति, अतः अहं छत्रं नयामि। (It is raining, therefore I take an umbrella.) (2) यतः वृक्षाः शुद्धं वायुं यच्छन्ति, अतः ते रक्षणीयाः। (Because trees give pure air, they must be protected.) Any grammatically correct sentences showing 'therefore' for अतः and 'because' for यतः earn full marks.
questions.explanation: अतः introduces a result; यतः introduces a reason and often pairs with अतः.

questions.question: List the five steps of paragraph writing (लेखनविधिः) in the correct order.
questions.answer: 1) विषयचयनम् — choose one limited topic. 2) विचारसंग्रहः — collect 4-6 ideas about it. 3) रूपरेखा — arrange the ideas into an outline. 4) लेखनम् — draft in simple, short sentences joined by connectives. 5) संशोधनम् — revise for unity, order, grammar, spelling and सन्धि, then write the fair copy.
questions.explanation: The five-step method taught in the lesson.

questions.question:
Correct all the errors in this mini-paragraph and rewrite it (there are four errors):
बालिकाः प्रातः उत्तिष्ठति। सा विद्यालये गच्छति। तत्र सा पाठं पठन्ति। रामेण अपि पाठं पठति।
questions.answer:
Corrected: बालिका प्रातः उत्तिष्ठति। सा विद्यालयं गच्छति। तत्र सा पाठं पठति। रामः अपि पाठं पठति।
Errors: (1) बालिकाः (plural) with उत्तिष्ठति (singular) — make the subject singular बालिका (or verb plural). (2) विद्यालये गच्छति — the goal of गम् takes द्वितीया: विद्यालयं गच्छति. (3) सा ... पठन्ति — singular subject needs singular verb पठति. (4) रामेण ... पठति — with an active verb the doer stays in प्रथमा: रामः पठति.
questions.explanation: Tests वचन agreement, कर्म in द्वितीया with गम्, and कर्ता in प्रथमा with active verbs.

questions.question:
Rearrange these jumbled sentences into a coherent paragraph on परिश्रमः and state which sentence is the मुख्यवाक्य:
(क) अतः वयं सर्वदा परिश्रमं कुर्याम।
(ख) परिश्रमः सफलतायाः मूलम् अस्ति।
(ग) किन्तु अलसः जनः जीवने कष्टम् अनुभवति।
(घ) यः परिश्रमं करोति, सः एव उन्नतिं प्राप्नोति।
questions.answer:
Correct order: (ख) परिश्रमः सफलतायाः मूलम् अस्ति। (घ) यः परिश्रमं करोति, सः एव उन्नतिं प्राप्नोति। (ग) किन्तु अलसः जनः जीवने कष्टम् अनुभवति। (क) अतः वयं सर्वदा परिश्रमं कुर्याम।
The मुख्यवाक्य is (ख) — it states the main idea ('effort is the root of success'); (घ) and (ग) support it by contrast, and (क), beginning with अतः, is the समापनवाक्य.
questions.explanation: Topic sentence first, supports next (positive then contrast with किन्तु), conclusion with अतः last.

questions.question: Write a paragraph of five to six simple Sanskrit sentences on मम विद्यालयः, following the structure मुख्यवाक्य — समर्थकवाक्य — समापनवाक्य. Give the English gist in one or two lines.
questions.answer:
Model: मम विद्यालयः नगरस्य मध्यभागे अस्ति। सः विशालः सुन्दरश्च अस्ति। विद्यालये एकः पुस्तकालयः विशालं क्रीडाक्षेत्रं च स्तः। शिक्षकाः अस्मान् स्नेहेन पाठयन्ति। छात्राः प्रातः प्रार्थनां कुर्वन्ति, ततः पठन्ति। अतः मम विद्यालयः मह्यं बहु रोचते।
Gist: My school is in the middle of the town; it is large and beautiful, with a library and playground; the teachers teach us affectionately; students pray and then study; therefore I love my school. Any original paragraph with correct grammar, one theme and the three-part structure earns full marks.
questions.explanation: Assesses structure (topic sentence, supports, अतः-conclusion), unity and correct simple Sanskrit.

questions.question: Write a paragraph of five to six Sanskrit sentences on पर्यावरणरक्षणम्, using at least three connectives (e.g. किन्तु, यतः, अतः, अपि च). Underline or list the connectives you used.
questions.answer:
Model: पर्यावरणं जीवनस्य आधारः अस्ति। वृक्षाः शुद्धं वायुं यच्छन्ति, नद्यः च जलं यच्छन्ति। किन्तु अद्य मानवः वृक्षान् छिनत्ति। यतः प्रदूषणं वर्धते, अतः रोगाः अपि वर्धन्ते। वयं वृक्षारोपणं कुर्याम, स्वच्छतां च पालयेम। अतः पर्यावरणरक्षणं सर्वेषां कर्तव्यम् अस्ति।
Connectives used: च, किन्तु, यतः, अतः, अपि. Any original paragraph with one theme, correct grammar and at least three connectives earns full marks.
questions.explanation: Assesses composition with deliberate use of connectives and the standard structure.

questions.explanation: Singular subject बालिका takes the singular verb गायति (subject-verb वचन agreement).

questions.question: Which sentence is grammatically correct?
questions.explanation: Plural subject छात्राः needs the plural verb क्रीडन्ति.

questions.question: What is the error in 'सः फलं खादन्ति'?
questions.explanation: सः (singular) needs खादति; खादन्ति is plural — a वचन disagreement.

questions.question: In a paragraph on 'मम विद्यालयः', which sentence breaks the unity (एकसूत्रता)?
questions.explanation: 'My uncle is a doctor' has nothing to do with the school — it must be removed.

questions.question: What is wrong with 'रामेण पुस्तकं पठति'?
options: the doer of an active verb must be in प्रथमा (रामः)
the object should be in तृतीया
questions.answer: the doer of an active verb must be in प्रथमा (रामः)
questions.explanation: With active पठति the कर्ता stays in प्रथमा: रामः पुस्तकं पठति।

questions.question: Which fault makes a paragraph a heap of disconnected statements?
questions.explanation: Without ततः, अतः, किन्तु etc. the sentences do not flow.

questions.question: Placing the conclusion first and the introduction last spoils which quality?
questions.explanation: Jumbled order destroys the paragraph even if each sentence is correct.

questions.question: Which is the correct way to write 'The boy goes to school'?
questions.explanation: The goal of गम् takes द्वितीया (विद्यालयम्), and the doer stays in प्रथमा.

questions.question: The natural word order of a Sanskrit sentence is
questions.explanation: Subject — object — verb: छात्रः पाठं पठति; the verb usually stands last.

questions.question: The कर्ता (doer) of an active sentence takes which विभक्ति?
questions.explanation: The doer stands in the nominative: छात्रः पठति।

questions.question: The कर्म (object) takes which विभक्ति?
questions.explanation: The object is accusative: पाठं पठति, विद्यालयं गच्छति।

questions.question: करण (the instrument, 'by/with') takes which विभक्ति?
questions.explanation: Instrumental: कन्दुकेन क्रीडति — plays WITH a ball.

questions.question: In 'छात्राय पुस्तकं यच्छति', the form 'छात्राय' is in which विभक्ति?
questions.explanation: The recipient (सम्प्रदान) takes the dative — gives TO the student.

questions.question: अधिकरण (location or time, 'in/at/on') takes which विभक्ति?
questions.explanation: Locative: विद्यालये, प्रातःकाले, अमावास्यायाम्।

questions.question: च + अपि =
questions.explanation: अ + अ = आ (दीर्घ-सन्धि): च + अपि = चापि।

questions.question: न + अस्ति =
questions.explanation: अ + अ = आ: न + अस्ति = नास्ति।

questions.question: An adjective must agree with its noun in
questions.explanation: E.g. नूतनानि वस्त्राणि (neuter plural), विशालं क्रीडाक्षेत्रम् (neuter singular).

questions.question: षष्ठी विभक्ति in composition expresses
questions.explanation: जीवनस्य आधारः, दीपानां पङ्क्तयः — षष्ठी links noun to noun and is not a कारक.

questions.question: A good paragraph should discuss many unrelated topics.
questions.explanation: One paragraph develops exactly ONE idea — the rule of एकसूत्रता.

questions.question: एकसूत्रता means unity of theme in a paragraph.
questions.explanation: All sentences hang on one thread of thought.

questions.question: The मुख्यवाक्यम् usually stands at the beginning of the paragraph.
questions.explanation: The topic sentence opens the paragraph and announces the theme.

questions.question: The समापनवाक्यम् should introduce a completely new topic.
questions.explanation: The conclusion sums up the existing idea; a new topic breaks the structure.

questions.question: Revision (संशोधनम्) is unnecessary once the draft is written.
questions.explanation: Revision for unity, order, grammar and सन्धि is the essential last step.

questions.question: The connective 'यतः' expresses a reason (because).
questions.explanation: यतः = because; it often pairs with अतः (therefore).

questions.question: The connective 'किन्तु' shows contrast between two statements.
questions.explanation: किन्तु = but/however: सः धनवान् अस्ति, किन्तु सुखी नास्ति।

questions.question: According to the model paragraph, दीपावली is celebrated on the अमावास्या of कार्तिक month.
questions.explanation: अयम् उत्सवः कार्तिकमासस्य अमावास्यायां भवति।

questions.question: The कर्म (object) of a sentence takes तृतीया विभक्ति.
questions.explanation: The object takes द्वितीया; तृतीया is for the instrument (करण).

questions.question: In a Sanskrit sentence the verb usually stands at the end.
questions.explanation: Default order is कर्ता-कर्म-क्रिया: छात्रः पाठं पठति।

questions.question: बालकः अस्वस्थः आसीत्, ____ (therefore) सः गृहे एव अतिष्ठत्।
questions.explanation: अतः = therefore, introducing the result of the illness.

questions.question: प्रथमं सः स्नानं करोति, ____ (then) पूजां करोति।
questions.explanation: ततः = then/after that, showing sequence after प्रथमम्.

questions.question: सः निर्धनः अस्ति, ____ (but) सत्यवादी अस्ति।
questions.explanation: किन्तु = but, marking the contrast poor-but-truthful. (परन्तु also acceptable.)

questions.question: ____ (because) वर्षा अभवत्, अतः क्रीडा स्थगिता अभवत्।
questions.explanation: यतः = because; it pairs with अतः in the result clause.

questions.question: यदि वयं परिश्रमं कुर्मः, ____ (then) सफलताम् आप्नुमः।
questions.explanation: The conditional frame is यदि ... तर्हि (if ... then).

questions.question: अनुच्छेदे विषयस्य एकता एव ____ इति उच्यते। (the quality of one single theme)
questions.explanation: एकसूत्रता = unity of theme, the first quality of a good paragraph.

questions.question: अनुच्छेदस्य प्रथमं वाक्यं, यत् मुख्यविचारं वदति, ____ इति कथ्यते।
questions.explanation: The first sentence stating the main idea is the मुख्यवाक्यम् (topic sentence).

questions.question: अनुच्छेदस्य अन्तिमं वाक्यं ____ इति कथ्यते।
questions.explanation: The last, concluding sentence is the समापनवाक्यम्.

questions.question: पर्यावरणं जीवनस्य ____ अस्ति। (model paragraph, topic sentence)
questions.explanation: The environment is the basis (आधारः) of life.

questions.question: अनुशासनं जीवनस्य ____ अस्ति। (model paragraph, topic sentence)
questions.explanation: Discipline is the ornament (अलङ्कारः) of life.

questions.question: दीपावली ____ मासस्य अमावास्यायां भवति। (name of the month)
questions.explanation: Deepavali falls on the new-moon day of the month Kartika (कार्तिकमासः).

questions.question: सन्धिं कुरुत — न + अस्ति = ____
questions.explanation: अ + अ = आ (दीर्घ-सन्धि): नास्ति।

questions.question: सन्धिं कुरुत — च + अपि = ____
questions.explanation: अ + अ = आ: चापि।

questions.question: वाक्ये कर्तुः विभक्तिः ____ भवति। (name of the vibhakti of the doer)
questions.explanation: The doer of an active sentence stands in प्रथमा विभक्ति (nominative).

questions.question: लेखनविधौ प्रथमं सोपानं विषयस्य ____ अस्ति। (the choosing/selection)
questions.explanation: Step 1 is विषयचयनम् — choosing one limited topic.

questions.question: What is an अनुच्छेद? Name any two of its qualities.
questions.answer: An अनुच्छेद (paragraph) is a small group of connected sentences that together develop one single idea. Two qualities (any two): एकसूत्रता (unity of theme), संगतिः (coherence), क्रमबद्धता (proper order), संक्षेपः (brevity), भाषाशुद्धिः (correct language).
questions.explanation: Definition plus any two of the five qualities.

questions.question: Explain एकसूत्रता with one example of a sentence that would break it.
questions.answer: एकसूत्रता (unity) means every sentence of the paragraph serves ONE main idea, like beads on one thread. Example of breaking it: in a paragraph on मम विद्यालयः, the sentence 'मम मातुलः वैद्यः अस्ति।' (My uncle is a doctor) is unrelated to the school and destroys the unity; it must be removed.
questions.explanation: Unity defined with a concrete stray-sentence example.

questions.question: What is संगतिः (coherence) and how is it achieved in a Sanskrit paragraph?
questions.answer: संगतिः is the logical connection between sentences — each sentence grows naturally out of the previous one so the reader moves smoothly from beginning to end. It is achieved by (1) arranging ideas in a sensible order (क्रमबद्धता) and (2) using connective words such as ततः, अतः, किन्तु, यतः, अपि च to tie the sentences together.
questions.explanation: Coherence = logical flow, achieved by ordering plus connectives.

questions.question: What is a मुख्यवाक्यम्? Give one example in Sanskrit.
questions.answer: The मुख्यवाक्यम् (topic sentence) is the sentence — usually the first — that states the main idea of the whole paragraph, so the reader knows the theme at once. Example: 'अनुशासनं जीवनस्य अलङ्कारः अस्ति।' or 'पर्यावरणं जीवनस्य आधारः अस्ति।'
questions.explanation: Definition plus a model topic sentence.

questions.question: State the role of समर्थकवाक्यानि in a paragraph. How many are usually written?
questions.answer: समर्थकवाक्यानि (supporting sentences) are the middle sentences that expand, explain, illustrate and justify the main idea — supplying details, examples and reasons. A paragraph usually has three to six supporting sentences.
questions.explanation: Supports develop the topic sentence; typically 3-6 of them.

questions.question: What makes a good समापनवाक्यम्? Quote one from the model paragraphs.
questions.answer: A good समापनवाक्यम् sums up the main idea or states its lesson in one sentence, often beginning with अतः; it must not open a new topic. Example from the models: 'अतः सर्वे छात्राः अनुशासनं पालयेयुः।' or 'अतः पर्यावरणरक्षणं सर्वेषां कर्तव्यम् अस्ति।'
questions.explanation: Conclusion = summing-up with अतः, no new theme.

questions.question: Why should a writer prepare a रूपरेखा (outline) before drafting the paragraph?
questions.answer: The outline arranges the collected points in a sensible order before writing: it fixes which point becomes the मुख्यवाक्य, which points support it and which concludes. This guarantees क्रमबद्धता (proper sequence) and unity, prevents repetition and stray sentences, and makes the actual drafting quick and smooth.
questions.explanation: Outlining orders ideas and protects unity and sequence.

questions.question: What exactly should be checked during संशोधनम् (revision)?
questions.answer: During revision one re-reads the draft to check: (1) unity — is any sentence off the topic? (2) order — do the ideas flow properly? (3) grammar — subject-verb agreement in पुरुष and वचन, adjective-noun agreement, correct विभक्ति; (4) spelling; and (5) सन्धि. Only after correcting these is the fair copy written.
questions.explanation: Revision covers content (unity, order) and language (agreement, vibhakti, sandhi, spelling).

questions.question: Give the meanings of ततः and अतः, and use each in a short Sanskrit sentence.
questions.answer: ततः = then / after that: 'प्रथमं सः स्नानं करोति, ततः पूजां करोति।' अतः = therefore / hence: 'वर्षा भवति, अतः अहं छत्रं नयामि।' ततः shows sequence of actions; अतः introduces a result or conclusion.
questions.explanation: Sequence (ततः) versus result (अतः).

questions.question: Use किन्तु in one Sanskrit sentence and यतः in another, with English meanings.
questions.answer: Model: (1) सः धनवान् अस्ति, किन्तु सुखी नास्ति। (He is rich, but not happy.) (2) यतः वृक्षाः शुद्धं वायुं यच्छन्ति, अतः ते रक्षणीयाः। (Because trees give pure air, they must be protected.) Any grammatically correct sentences showing contrast (किन्तु) and reason (यतः) are acceptable.
questions.explanation: किन्तु marks contrast; यतः gives a reason, usually answered by अतः.

questions.question: Distinguish between अपि च and किन्तु with one example each.
questions.answer: अपि च (moreover, and also) ADDS a point in the same direction: 'सः पठति। अपि च सः क्रीडति।' (He studies. Moreover he plays.) किन्तु (but) turns the statement AGAINST the previous one — contrast: 'सः पठति, किन्तु न लिखति।' (He reads, but does not write.) Addition vs contrast is the difference.
questions.explanation: अपि च = addition; किन्तु = contrast.

questions.question: Explain the frame यदि ... तर्हि and compose one Sanskrit sentence with it.
questions.answer: यदि ... तर्हि is the conditional frame 'if ... then': यदि introduces the condition, तर्हि the consequence. Model sentence: 'यदि वयं पर्यावरणं रक्षामः, तर्हि पर्यावरणम् अस्मान् रक्षति।' (If we protect the environment, then the environment protects us.)
questions.explanation: Condition + consequence; any correct यदि-तर्हि sentence is acceptable.

questions.question: From the model paragraph 'मम विद्यालयः': name the facilities of the school and translate the sentence 'ते अस्मान् श्रद्धया पाठयन्ति।'
questions.answer: Facilities: twenty classrooms (विंशतिः कक्ष्याः), a library (पुस्तकालयः), a science laboratory (विज्ञानागारम्) and a large playground (विशालं क्रीडाक्षेत्रम्). Translation: 'They (the teachers) teach us with devotion/care.' — श्रद्धया is तृतीया, 'with reverence'.
questions.explanation: Content comprehension plus translation with the instrumental श्रद्धया.

questions.question: What duties does the पर्यावरणम् model paragraph suggest, and in which mood (लकार) are they expressed?
questions.answer: The paragraph suggests: planting trees (वृक्षारोपणं कुर्याम), protecting water (जलं रक्षेम) and keeping cleanliness (स्वच्छतां पालयेम). These are expressed in the विधिलिङ् (optative mood), the polite 'let us / should' form used for advice and duties — कुर्याम, रक्षेम, पालयेम are first-person plural optatives.
questions.explanation: Duties listed in विधिलिङ् — the mood of polite advice.

questions.question: According to the दीपावली model paragraph, what do people and children do on the festival day?
questions.answer: People clean their houses (गृहाणि स्वच्छानि कुर्वन्ति) and light lamps (दीपान् ज्वालयन्ति); children wear new clothes (नूतनानि वस्त्राणि धारयन्ति) and eat sweets (मिष्टान्नानि खादन्ति). At night rows of lamps shine everywhere, and moreover people perform the worship of goddess Lakshmi (लक्ष्मीदेव्याः पूजनम्).
questions.explanation: Comprehension of the supporting sentences of the दीपावली paragraph.

questions.question: How does the अनुशासनम् model paragraph show that nature itself observes discipline? Translate the relevant sentence.
questions.answer: The paragraph says: 'सूर्यः समये उदेति, ऋतवः क्रमेण आगच्छन्ति — एवं प्रकृतिः अपि अनुशासनं पालयति।' Translation: 'The sun rises on time, the seasons come in order — thus nature too observes discipline.' Nature's punctual sun and ordered seasons are the examples of natural discipline.
questions.explanation: Nature's discipline: the punctual sun and the ordered seasons.

questions.question: Correct the errors: (a) बालिकाः गीतं गायति। (b) सः विद्यालये गच्छति। (for 'He goes to school')
questions.answer: (a) बालिकाः गीतं गायन्ति। — the plural subject बालिकाः needs the plural verb गायन्ति (or make the subject singular: बालिका गीतं गायति।). (b) सः विद्यालयं गच्छति। — the goal of the verb गम् (to go) takes द्वितीया विभक्ति (विद्यालयम्), not सप्तमी (विद्यालये).
questions.explanation: Subject-verb वचन agreement; the destination of गम् is कर्म in द्वितीया.

questions.question:
Read this mini-paragraph and pick out the sentence that breaks unity, giving your reason:
वृक्षाः अस्माकं मित्राणि सन्ति। ते फलानि छायां च यच्छन्ति। मम भ्राता क्रिकेटक्रीडां क्रीडति। अतः वयं वृक्षान् रक्षेम।
questions.answer: The sentence 'मम भ्राता क्रिकेटक्रीडां क्रीडति।' (My brother plays cricket) breaks the unity. Reason: the paragraph's single theme is trees as our friends — their gifts and our duty to protect them; a statement about the writer's brother's cricket has no connection with that theme, so एकसूत्रता is violated and the sentence must be removed.
questions.explanation: Identifying the stray sentence and justifying by the rule of unity.

questions.question: State the विभक्ति used for कर्ता, कर्म and करण in composition, with one example each.
questions.answer: कर्ता (doer) → प्रथमा: छात्रः पठति। कर्म (object) → द्वितीया: छात्रः पाठं पठति। करण (instrument, 'by/with') → तृतीया: बालकः कन्दुकेन क्रीडति। (The boy plays with a ball.)
questions.explanation: The three core कारक-विभक्ति pairings used constantly in paragraph writing.

questions.question: Perform the सन्धि and name its type: (a) न + अस्ति (b) च + अपि (c) सुन्दरः + च
questions.answer: (a) न + अस्ति = नास्ति — दीर्घ-सन्धि (अ + अ = आ). (b) च + अपि = चापि — दीर्घ-सन्धि (अ + अ = आ). (c) सुन्दरः + च = सुन्दरश्च — विसर्ग-सन्धि (the visarga ः before च becomes श्).
questions.explanation: The three sandhis most used in the model paragraphs.

questions.question: Explain subject-verb agreement in Sanskrit with the verb पठ् (to read) across the three persons in singular, and give one plural example.
questions.answer: The verb agrees with the कर्ता in पुरुष (person) and वचन (number). With पठ् in लट् लकार: अहं पठामि (I read — उत्तमपुरुष), त्वं पठसि (you read — मध्यमपुरुष), सः पठति (he reads — प्रथमपुरुष). Plural example: ते पठन्ति (they read) or छात्राः पठन्ति — a plural subject demands the plural verb form.
questions.explanation: पठामि / पठसि / पठति across persons; पठन्ति for plural.

questions.question: Compose three connected Sanskrit sentences on 'मम विद्यालयः' — a topic sentence, one support, and a conclusion with अतः.
questions.answer: Model: मम विद्यालयः अतीव सुन्दरः अस्ति। (topic sentence) तत्र शिक्षकाः अस्मान् स्नेहेन पाठयन्ति। (support) अतः मम विद्यालयः मह्यं बहु रोचते। (conclusion) Any three grammatically correct, connected sentences on the school with this structure earn full marks.
questions.explanation: Miniature paragraph testing structure and correct simple Sanskrit.

questions.question: Write a Sanskrit paragraph of five to six sentences on 'मम दिनचर्या' (My daily routine), using the sequence connectives प्रथमम्, ततः and अन्ते. Give a one-line English gist.
questions.answer:
Model: अहं प्रातः पञ्चवादने उत्तिष्ठामि। प्रथमं स्नानं करोमि, ततः ईश्वरं प्रणमामि। ततः अहं विद्यालयं गच्छामि, तत्र च पठामि। सायङ्काले क्रीडाक्षेत्रे क्रीडामि। अन्ते अहं गृहपाठं कृत्वा दशवादने शयनं करोमि। एवं मम दिनचर्या नियमिता अस्ति।
Gist: I rise at five, bathe and pray first, then go to school and study, play in the evening, and finally finish homework and sleep at ten — thus my routine is regular. Any original paragraph with correct grammar, one theme and the three sequence connectives earns full marks.
questions.explanation: Sequence-ordered composition; the connectives प्रथमम्-ततः-अन्ते supply the क्रमबद्धता.

questions.question: Write a Sanskrit paragraph of five to six sentences on 'वृक्षाणां महत्त्वम्' (The importance of trees), using at least three different connectives, and end with a समापनवाक्य beginning with अतः.
questions.answer:
Model: वृक्षाः प्रकृत्याः वरदानम् सन्ति। ते शुद्धं वायुं फलानि छायां च यच्छन्ति। अपि च वृक्षाः वर्षायै साहाय्यं कुर्वन्ति। किन्तु अद्य जनाः वृक्षान् छिन्दन्ति। यतः वृक्षाः विना जीवनं न सम्भवति, अतः वयं वृक्षारोपणं कुर्याम। अतः वृक्षाणां रक्षणम् अस्माकं परमं कर्तव्यम् अस्ति।
Connectives used: च, अपि च, किन्तु, यतः, अतः. Any original paragraph with one theme, three or more connectives, correct grammar and an अतः-conclusion earns full marks.
questions.explanation: Tests composition with deliberate connective use and the standard structure.

questions.question: Write a Sanskrit paragraph of five to six sentences on 'मम प्रियः उत्सवः' (My favourite festival — choose any festival except दीपावली), following the full structure: मुख्यवाक्य, समर्थकवाक्यानि, समापनवाक्य.
questions.answer:
Model (होलिका/होली): होलिका मम प्रियः उत्सवः अस्ति। अयम् उत्सवः फाल्गुनमासे भवति। तस्मिन् दिने जनाः विविधैः वर्णैः क्रीडन्ति। बालकाः वृद्धाः च आनन्देन नृत्यन्ति गायन्ति च। अपि च जनाः परस्परं मिष्टान्नानि यच्छन्ति। अतः होलिका स्नेहस्य आनन्दस्य च उत्सवः अस्ति।
Structure: topic sentence (Holi is my favourite festival), supports (month, playing with colours, dancing and singing, sharing sweets), conclusion with अतः. Any festival paragraph with this structure and correct grammar earns full marks.
questions.explanation: Transfer task: apply the दीपावली model's structure to a new festival.

questions.question: Write a Sanskrit paragraph of five to six sentences on 'परिश्रमस्य महत्त्वम्' (The importance of effort), using the frames यः...सः and यदि...तर्हि at least once each.
questions.answer:
Model: परिश्रमः सफलतायाः मूलम् अस्ति। यः परिश्रमं करोति, सः एव जीवने उन्नतिं प्राप्नोति। यदि छात्रः प्रतिदिनं पठति, तर्हि सः परीक्षायाम् उत्तमान् अङ्कान् प्राप्नोति। किन्तु अलसः जनः कष्टम् अनुभवति। अपि च परिश्रमेण एव देशस्य उन्नतिः भवति। अतः वयं सर्वदा परिश्रमं कुर्याम।
Both frames appear: यः परिश्रमं करोति, सः... and यदि...तर्हि. Any original paragraph with the two frames, one theme and correct grammar earns full marks.
questions.explanation: Composition with the correlative frames यः-सः and यदि-तर्हि.

questions.question: Explain the complete structure of an ideal अनुच्छेद — मुख्यवाक्यम्, समर्थकवाक्यानि and समापनवाक्यम् — illustrating each part from the model paragraph on अनुशासनम्.
questions.answer: An ideal paragraph has three parts. (1) मुख्यवाक्यम् (topic sentence): the opening sentence stating the main idea — in the model, 'अनुशासनं जीवनस्य अलङ्कारः अस्ति।' announces that discipline is life's ornament. (2) समर्थकवाक्यानि (supporting sentences): three to six middle sentences that expand and justify the idea — the model supports with the student's routine (rising early, exercising, reaching school on time), nature's discipline (the punctual sun, the ordered seasons), and the यः...सः contrast between the disciplined person who progresses and the undisciplined one who suffers. (3) समापनवाक्यम् (conclusion): the last sentence sums up the lesson, often with अतः — 'अतः सर्वे छात्राः अनुशासनं पालयेयुः।' The conclusion never opens a new topic. Together the three parts give the paragraph unity, flow and completeness.
questions.explanation: Structure explained and mapped sentence-by-sentence onto the अनुशासनम् model.

questions.question: Describe the complete five-step method of paragraph writing, showing how you would apply each step to the topic 'पर्यावरणरक्षणम्'.
questions.answer: Step 1 विषयचयनम्: fix the limited topic — protection of the environment (not 'the whole world'). Step 2 विचारसंग्रहः: jot points — environment is life's basis; trees give air, rivers give water; man cuts trees and pollutes; pollution brings disease; our duties — plant trees, keep clean. Step 3 रूपरेखा: order them — definition first (मुख्यवाक्य), nature's gifts, the problem (किन्तु), cause-effect (यतः...अतः), duties, and the conclusion 'protection is everyone's duty'. Step 4 लेखनम्: draft in simple लट्-लकार sentences joined by connectives, one idea per sentence. Step 5 संशोधनम्: re-read for unity, order, agreement, विभक्ति, spelling and सन्धि, correct, and write the fair copy.
questions.explanation: The five steps applied concretely to the पर्यावरणरक्षणम् topic.

questions.question: Discuss five common errors of paragraph writing with one example each, and state how a writer can avoid them.
questions.answer: (1) Broken unity: an unrelated sentence — e.g. 'मम मातुलः वैद्यः अस्ति' inside a school paragraph; avoid by testing every sentence against the theme. (2) Jumbled order: conclusion before the supports; avoid by making a रूपरेखा first. (3) पुनरुक्तिः: saying 'trees are useful' twice in different words; avoid by drafting one idea per sentence and revising. (4) Agreement errors: 'बालिकाः गायति' (plural subject, singular verb) — correct to गायन्ति; avoid by checking पुरुष-वचन agreement in revision. (5) Wrong विभक्ति: 'रामेण पुस्तकं पठति' — the doer of an active verb stays in प्रथमा, रामः; likewise 'विद्यालये गच्छति' should be विद्यालयं गच्छति (goal of गम् in द्वितीया); avoid by recalling the कारक-विभक्ति table during संशोधनम्. Careful outlining before writing and systematic revision after writing prevent nearly all these faults.
questions.explanation: Five faults with examples and the preventive habit (outline + revision) for each.

questions.question: 'Connectives are the glue of a Sanskrit paragraph.' Justify this statement, explaining the use of at least five connectives with example sentences.
questions.answer: Without connectives a paragraph is a heap of disconnected statements; with them the sentences flow as one argument — hence 'glue'. (1) ततः (then) chains actions: 'प्रथमं सः स्नानं करोति, ततः पूजां करोति।' (2) अतः (therefore) draws the result and typically opens the conclusion: 'वर्षा भवति, अतः छत्रं नय।' (3) किन्तु (but) admits a contrast without breaking the flow: 'सः धनवान् अस्ति, किन्तु सुखी नास्ति।' (4) यतः (because) supplies the reason and pairs with अतः: 'यतः प्रदूषणं वर्धते, अतः रोगाः वर्धन्ते।' (5) अपि च (moreover) adds a parallel point: 'सः पठति। अपि च सः क्रीडति।' Others — तथापि (nevertheless), यदा-तदा, यदि-तर्हि, and postposed च — serve the same binding function. By marking sequence, reason, result, contrast and addition, connectives create the संगतिः (coherence) that turns correct sentences into a true अनुच्छेद.
questions.explanation: Connectives create coherence by signalling the logical relations between sentences.

questions.question:
Read the passage and answer:
मम विद्यालयः नगरस्य मध्यभागे अस्ति। सः विशालः सुन्दरश्च अस्ति। छात्राः प्रातः प्रार्थनां कुर्वन्ति, ततः पठनम् आरभन्ते। अतः मम विद्यालयः मह्यं बहु रोचते।
(a) Which sentence is the मुख्यवाक्यम्? (b) Which connective shows sequence? (c) Translate the last sentence.
questions.answer: (a) The first sentence — 'मम विद्यालयः नगरस्य मध्यभागे अस्ति।' — is the मुख्यवाक्यम्, stating the theme. (b) ततः (then) shows the sequence: prayer first, then study. (c) 'Therefore my school pleases me greatly / I like my school very much.' (रुच् takes the dative मह्यम्; अतः marks the conclusion.)
questions.explanation: Identifying the topic sentence, the sequence connective ततः, and translating the अतः-conclusion.

questions.question:
Read the passage and answer:
पर्यावरणं जीवनस्य आधारः अस्ति। वृक्षाः शुद्धं वायुं यच्छन्ति। किन्तु अद्य मानवः वृक्षान् छिनत्ति। यतः प्रदूषणं वर्धते, अतः रोगाः अपि वर्धन्ते।
(a) What is the theme? (b) Which connective introduces the problem? (c) Which pair of connectives shows cause and effect?
questions.answer: (a) The theme is the environment as the basis of life (and its endangerment) — पर्यावरणम्. (b) किन्तु (but) introduces the problem: man cuts the trees. (c) The pair यतः ... अतः shows cause and effect: BECAUSE pollution grows, THEREFORE diseases also grow.
questions.explanation: Theme from the topic sentence; किन्तु for the turn; यतः-अतः for reason-result.

questions.question:
Read the passage and answer:
दीपावली भारतीयानां प्रमुखः उत्सवः अस्ति। तस्मिन् दिने जनाः दीपान् ज्वालयन्ति। बालकाः नूतनानि वस्त्राणि धारयन्ति। किन्तु वयं स्फोटकानां प्रयोगं न कुर्याम, यतः तेन प्रदूषणं भवति।
(a) What do people do on that day? (b) What advice does the passage give and why? (c) In 'नूतनानि वस्त्राणि', in what do the adjective and noun agree?
questions.answer: (a) People light lamps (दीपान् ज्वालयन्ति) and children wear new clothes. (b) Advice: we should not use firecrackers (स्फोटकानां प्रयोगं न कुर्याम), because (यतः) their use causes pollution. (c) The adjective नूतनानि agrees with the noun वस्त्राणि in लिङ्ग (neuter), वचन (plural) and विभक्ति (द्वितीया) — the rule of adjective-noun agreement.
questions.explanation: Comprehension plus the agreement rule illustrated by नूतनानि वस्त्राणि.

questions.question:
Read the passage and answer:
अनुशासनं जीवनस्य अलङ्कारः अस्ति। छात्रः प्रातः उत्तिष्ठति, व्यायामं करोति, समये च विद्यालयं गच्छति। सूर्यः समये उदेति, ऋतवः क्रमेण आगच्छन्ति। अतः सर्वे छात्राः अनुशासनं पालयेयुः।
(a) Label each sentence as मुख्यवाक्य, समर्थकवाक्य or समापनवाक्य. (b) What form is पालयेयुः and why is it used?
questions.answer: (a) Sentence 1 (अनुशासनं जीवनस्य अलङ्कारः अस्ति) = मुख्यवाक्यम्; sentences 2 and 3 (the student's routine; the sun and the seasons) = समर्थकवाक्यानि; sentence 4 (अतः सर्वे छात्राः...) = समापनवाक्यम्. (b) पालयेयुः is विधिलिङ् (optative), third person plural — 'they should observe'. The optative is used because the conclusion gives polite advice/duty, the standard mood for a paragraph's closing recommendation.
questions.explanation: Structural labelling plus recognition of the optative in the conclusion.

questions.question:
The sentences of a paragraph on 'उद्यानम्' (the garden) are jumbled. Arrange them in the correct order and name the quality restored:
(क) अतः उद्यानं सर्वेषां प्रियम् अस्ति।
(ख) उद्यानं नगरस्य शोभा अस्ति।
(ग) तत्र विविधानि पुष्पाणि विकसन्ति।
(घ) प्रातः जनाः तत्र भ्रमणं कुर्वन्ति।
questions.answer: Correct order: (ख) उद्यानं नगरस्य शोभा अस्ति। (topic sentence) → (ग) तत्र विविधानि पुष्पाणि विकसन्ति। (support) → (घ) प्रातः जनाः तत्र भ्रमणं कुर्वन्ति। (support) → (क) अतः उद्यानं सर्वेषां प्रियम् अस्ति। (conclusion with अतः). The quality restored is क्रमबद्धता (proper sequence) — topic sentence first, supports next, conclusion last.
questions.explanation: Reordering by the मुख्यवाक्य-समर्थक-समापन pattern restores क्रमबद्धता.

questions.question:
Read the paragraph and answer:
पुस्तकानि अस्माकं मित्राणि सन्ति। तानि ज्ञानं यच्छन्ति। मम गृहे एका धेनुः अस्ति। पुस्तकानि पठित्वा वयं विद्वांसः भवामः। अतः वयं पुस्तकानि रक्षेम।
(a) Which sentence breaks the unity and why? (b) After removing it, is the paragraph complete in structure? Explain.
questions.answer: (a) 'मम गृहे एका धेनुः अस्ति।' (There is a cow in my house) breaks the unity — the paragraph's single theme is books as friends, and a cow at home is unrelated, violating एकसूत्रता. (b) Yes: after removal the paragraph is structurally complete — मुख्यवाक्यम् ('पुस्तकानि अस्माकं मित्राणि सन्ति।'), two समर्थकवाक्यानि (books give knowledge; by reading them we become learned), and a समापनवाक्यम् with अतः ('अतः वयं पुस्तकानि रक्षेम।').
questions.explanation: Stray-sentence detection plus verification of the three-part structure.

questions.question:
This draft paragraph contains three grammatical errors. Find and correct them:
जलं जीवनम् अस्ति। सर्वे जीवाः जलेन विना जीवितुं न शक्नोति। वयं जलस्य अपव्ययं न कुर्मः इति उचितम्। बालकाः अपि जलं रक्षति। अतः जलरक्षणं परमं कर्तव्यम् अस्ति।
questions.answer: Error 1: 'सर्वे जीवाः ... न शक्नोति' — plural subject with singular verb; correct: न शक्नुवन्ति। Error 2: 'बालकाः अपि जलं रक्षति' — plural subject with singular verb; correct: रक्षन्ति। Error 3 (structural/idiomatic): 'वयं ... न कुर्मः इति उचितम्' — the advice should be in विधिलिङ्: 'वयं जलस्य अपव्ययं न कुर्याम।' Corrected paragraph: जलं जीवनम् अस्ति। सर्वे जीवाः जलेन विना जीवितुं न शक्नुवन्ति। वयं जलस्य अपव्ययं न कुर्याम। बालकाः अपि जलं रक्षन्ति। अतः जलरक्षणं परमं कर्तव्यम् अस्ति।
questions.explanation: Two वचन-agreement errors (शक्नुवन्ति, रक्षन्ति) and the optative कुर्याम for advice.

questions.question:
Fill the three blanks with suitable connectives from (अतः, किन्तु, ततः):
छात्रः प्रातः उत्तिष्ठति, ____ व्यायामं करोति। सः पठने कुशलः अस्ति, ____ क्रीडायां न कुशलः। सः प्रतिदिनं परिश्रमं करोति, ____ सः परीक्षायाम् उत्तीर्णः भवति।
questions.answer: Blank 1: ततः (rises, THEN exercises — sequence). Blank 2: किन्तु (good at study BUT not at games — contrast). Blank 3: अतः (works daily, THEREFORE passes — result). Completed: ...उत्तिष्ठति, ततः व्यायामं करोति। ...कुशलः अस्ति, किन्तु क्रीडायां न कुशलः। ...परिश्रमं करोति, अतः सः परीक्षायाम् उत्तीर्णः भवति।
questions.explanation: Choosing sequence, contrast and result connectives by the logic of each pair of clauses.

questions.question:
Read the paragraph and answer:
परोपकारः परमः धर्मः अस्ति। वृक्षाः परोपकाराय फलानि यच्छन्ति। नद्यः परोपकाराय जलं वहन्ति। अतः वयम् अपि परोपकारं कुर्याम।
(a) Identify the समापनवाक्यम्. (b) How do the two middle sentences support the main idea? (c) What is the theme in one English phrase?
questions.answer: (a) The समापनवाक्यम् is 'अतः वयम् अपि परोपकारं कुर्याम।' — the अतः-conclusion urging us also to serve others. (b) The middle sentences support by examples from nature: trees give fruits for others' good, rivers carry water for others' good — nature itself models the main idea. (c) Theme: 'service to others (helping others) is the highest duty'.
questions.explanation: Conclusion identification, the example-based supports, and the theme of परोपकार.

questions.question:
Two draft paragraphs on 'मम माता' are compared:
Draft A: मम माता स्नेहमयी अस्ति। सा प्रातः भोजनं पचति। सा मां पाठं पाठयति। अतः अहं मातरं प्रणमामि।
Draft B: मम माता स्नेहमयी अस्ति। मम पिता कार्यालयं गच्छति। क्रिकेटक्रीडा उत्तमा अस्ति। सा मां स्निह्यति।
Which draft is the better paragraph? Judge it on unity, coherence and structure.
questions.answer: Draft A is better. Unity: every sentence of A is about the mother; B drifts to the father's office and to cricket — two stray sentences break एकसूत्रता. Coherence and order: A moves smoothly from the topic sentence (mother is affectionate) through supports (she cooks, she teaches) to a conclusion; B's sentences have no logical connection. Structure: A has a clear मुख्यवाक्य, समर्थकवाक्यानि and an अतः-समापनवाक्य ('अतः अहं मातरं प्रणमामि।'); B has a topic sentence but no true supports or conclusion. Hence A satisfies all the qualities of a good अनुच्छेद while B fails on unity, coherence and structure.
questions.explanation: Evaluation against the three criteria: unity, coherence/order, three-part structure.
